# STITCHIQ

> AI embroidery digitizing studio. Converts raster/vector images and text into
> machine-ready embroidery stitch files, in the browser, with a measured
> quality pipeline.

## What it does

- Auto-digitizing: image -> stitch objects with satin columns (medial axis),
  tatami fills with angle selection, contour/spiral/radial curved fills,
  underlay (centre-walk, edge-walk, zigzag, parallel), pull compensation,
  tie-off locks, travel routing and trim minimization.
- Photo pipeline: textured/photographed sources get mean-shift cleanup, speck
  absorption, gradient-band colour recovery, dark-linework overlay, and a
  sketch-verify pass that redraws the colour plan when its outline misses the
  artwork's structure.
- Lettering: text -> stitches with straight or arc baselines.
- Quality: 0-100 score with itemized findings; density, floor and machine-cap
  checks; angle-fair coverage measurement.
- Export: DST, PES, JEF, EXP, VP3, plus a production package ZIP (machine file,
  worksheet PDF, colour card, preview, summary).
- Accounts: local-first profiles with email PIN recovery, roles (admin/user)
  and plans (free/pro/studio); optional Supabase cloud persistence.

## Facts

- Backend: FastAPI (Python), OpenCV classical CV pipeline; frontend: React +
  TypeScript + Vite (Node.js).
- Every capability claim traces to a measured audit in docs/benchmarks/ in the
  repository — "supported" means generated and tested, not declared.
